mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.project_id, tc.title, tc.module, tc.tags FROM test_case tc WHERE tc.project_id != #{excludeProjectId} AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tc.review_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY tc.id

SELECT l.test_case_id, a.atomic_text, a.type FROM test_case_requirement_link l JOIN atomic_requirement a ON a.id = l.atomic_requirement_id JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = l.test_case_id WHERE tc.project_id != #{excludeProjectId} AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tc.review_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY l.id
